const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  function eeGet(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.evaluate((res, err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(res)));
    });
  }

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const arctic = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
      [[[-180, 63], [180, 63], [180, 90], [-180, 90], [-180, 63]]],
      null,
      false
    );
    const band = 'total_column_ozone';
    const primaryDS = 'ECMWF/ERA5/DAILY';
    const fallbackDS = 'ECMWF/ERA5/MONTHLY';

    const periods = [
      { label: 'Apr-2011', start: '2011-04-01', end: '2011-05-01' },
      { label: 'Apr-2014', start: '2014-04-01', end: '2014-05-01' },
    ];

    async function getPeriodStats(p) {
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(primaryDS).select(band).filterDate(p.start, p.end);
      let sz = await eeGet(col.size());
      let usedDS = primaryDS;
      if ((sz || 0) === 0) {
        col = ee.ImageCollection(fallbackDS).select(band).filterDate(p.start, p.end);
        sz = await eeGet(col.size());
        usedDS = fallbackDS;
      }
      if ((sz || 0) === 0) {
        return { status: 'C1', usedDS: null, images: 0 };
      }
      const img = col.mean();

      const meanDict = await eeGet(
        img.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: arctic,
          scale: 30000,
          maxPixels: 1e9,
        })
      );
      const countDict = await eeGet(
        img.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: arctic,
          scale: 30000,
          maxPixels: 1e9,
        })
      );

      const mean = meanDict ? meanDict[band] : null;
      const count = countDict ? countDict[band] : 0;

      return { status: 'OK', usedDS, images: sz, mean, count };
    }

    const s1 = await getPeriodStats(periods[0]);
    const s2 = await getPeriodStats(periods[1]);

    // 2. Data Acquisition Checks
    console.log(`Dataset/Images ${periods[0].label}: ${s1.usedDS || 'None'} / ${s1.images}`);
    console.log(`Dataset/Images ${periods[1].label}: ${s2.usedDS || 'None'} / ${s2.images}`);
    if (s1.status === 'C1' || s2.status === 'C1') {
      console.log('Empty collection in at least one period.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Valid Pixels Check
    console.log(`${periods[0].label} Valid Pixels: ${s1.count}`);
    console.log(`${periods[1].label} Valid Pixels: ${s2.count}`);
    if ((s1.count || 0) === 0 || (s2.count || 0) === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after processing.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation & Validation
    const m1 = s1.mean;
    const m2 = s2.mean;
    console.log(`${periods[0].label} Mean tco (kg/m^2): ${m1 !== null ? m1.toFixed(6) : 'null'}`);
    console.log(`${periods[1].label} Mean tco (kg/m^2): ${m2 !== null ? m2.toFixed(6) : 'null'}`);

    const invalid =
      m1 === null ||
      m2 === null ||
      !isFinite(m1) ||
      !isFinite(m2) ||
      m1 <= 0 ||
      m2 <= 0 ||
      m1 > 0.2 ||
      m2 > 0.2;
    if (invalid) {
      console.log('Calculation failed or out-of-range values.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Final Answer (2014 > 2011 ?)
    const increased = m2 > m1;
    console.log(`Change (2014 - 2011): ${(m2 - m1).toFixed(6)} kg/m^2`);
    console.log(increased ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e.message || e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
